en: A black‑and‑white view of a broad, cobblestoned, tree‑lined street in an old European city. On the left are several ornate multi‑story townhouses with rich stucco decoration; on the right a wide sidewalk shaded by tall trees runs alongside a substantial public building on the corner. A small monument or pedestal stands at the corner in front of the building, and several people in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing—women in long dresses and hats, men in suits—are standing or walking along the street. The overall feel is of a calm, upper‑middle‑class residential or institutional quarter. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image.
